title: Split-brain per-profile retry/timeout
description: Implemented profile-aware provider retry policy in agent-runtime. Added retryConfig with finite per-profile retry/backoff settings, wrapped provider turns in withProviderRetry, logged each retry attempt, and validated with expanded unit tests plus a full build.

title: Refractory scheduler
description: Implemented a source-group refractory scheduler in agent-runtime. Internal jobs and non-direct mail now fall into a 10-30s randomized refractory window keyed by source group, while direct/private and urgent mail remain hot and bypass cooldown entirely. Added policy tests for refractory jitter and hot-vs-refractory classification, and verified with bun test plus full build.

title: Profile-specific Timeout Policy
description: Implemented profile-specific turn timeouts in agent-runtime. Added turnProfileConfig with FLEET_LIGHT_TIMEOUT_MS / FLEET_FULL_TIMEOUT_MS / FLEET_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS fallback to FLEET_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS, applied to provider turn timeout and deadman timer, added unit tests, validated with bun test and bun run scripts/build.ts.

title: Source Group Classification
description: Implemented deterministic source-group classification in agent-runtime. Added classifySourceGroup with internal/urgent/direct/social/ambient groups, threaded sourceGroup through wake selection, used it in governor bump and forced cooldown reasons, added unit tests, and validated with bun test plus bun run scripts/build.ts.

title: Randomized Cooldown Implementation
description: Implemented randomized cooldown fallback for transient provider-capacity limits in agent-runtime. Parsed provider retry/reset windows still win, quota exhaustion remains fixed at one hour, and transient fallback now uses a randomized 10-30s refractory window. Added policy tests and verified with bun test plus full build.

title: Alarm & Reminders Schema
description: Implemented alarm/reminder schema in agent-jobs. Added fleet_job_alarms table, alarm-set/list/cancel commands, documented usage in README, added a CLI-level alarm test, and validated with bun test plus bun run scripts/build.ts.

title: Local Event Integration
description: Added local event integration to agent-jobs. Introduced a durable fleet_local_events queue with publish/peek/claim/complete/list commands, rebuild/verify support, stale-claim recovery, JSONL projection records, and focused lifecycle tests. Also fixed the existing optional fifth-argument parsing bug in agent-jobs so queue/alarm/event commands read their trailing parameters correctly.

title: Status Transition Logic
description: Implemented runtime status transition logic in agent-state. Runtime state writes now validate against an explicit status vocabulary and transition graph, normalize incompatible fields by status (for example clearing cooldown_until outside cooldown/sleep/rate-limit states), and reject impossible jumps like idle -> sleeping. Added focused transition tests and verified with bun test plus full build.

title: Mail Filter Integration
description: Integrated mail filtering with agent subscriptions. agent-mail now consults fleet_channel_subscriptions from agent-state and suppresses public channel bursts when the agent is unsubscribed, while allowing delivery again once resume_at has passed. chat:general is derived from public broadcasts, public ad-hoc recipients map to their channel name, and direct/urgent mail remains unfiltered. Added focused transport tests and validated with bun test plus full build.
